title: #151 Bad Media
prompt: Internet or media is bad for young people because they make the young generation poor in communication and forming relationships. Do you agree with this opinion? Please use examples or your personal experience to support your idea.

promptSegments.text: Internet or media is bad for young people because they make the young generation poor in communication and forming relationships.
Do you agree with this opinion?
Please use examples or your personal experience to support your idea.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Spending too much time on media makes young people poor at talking to others.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spending too much time on media makes young people poor at talking to others.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media use can also hurt how young people form relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media use can also hurt how young people form relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The internet helps young people build connections by allowing them to join online groups and talk about their hobbies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The internet helps young people build connections by allowing them to join online groups and talk about their hobbies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media helps young people learn new things and find support by providing educational content like videos about school subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media helps young people learn new things and find support by providing educational content like videos about school subjects.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses how bad media affects mental health, using the PEEL structure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph discusses how bad media affects mental health, using the PEEL structure.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses how bad media lowers public knowledge, also following the PEEL structure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph discusses how bad media lowers public knowledge, also following the PEEL structure.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The media provides numerous opportunities for young people to learn and grow, giving them access to diverse information and perspectives, such as collaborating on school projects online, which enhances their ability to share ideas and solve problems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The media provides numerous opportunities for young people to learn and grow, giving them access to diverse information and perspectives, such as collaborating on school projects online, which enhances their ability to share ideas and solve problems.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, media assists young people in developing crucial social skills by connecting them with like-minded individuals through hobby forums, leading to increased confidence and a feeling of belonging.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, media assists young people in developing crucial social skills by connecting them with like-minded individuals through hobby forums, leading to increased confidence and a feeling of belonging.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
